displayQualification: Unchanged corrected #242 idle-display and mounted workload probes; rejected windows contribute no timings

runner.filter: --only-repetition selects one of the configured three repetitions per invocation
runner.manifest: Runner asset hash updated and pairedRunnerChange recorded
runner.analysis: Combine all three complete invocations before corrected analyzer validation

cpu.qualification: cpuIntervalQualified must be true for every analyzed row

attribution.snapshotShare: 100 * sum exclusive snapshot milliseconds / sum renderer-main RunTask milliseconds
attribution.getViewShare: 100 * sum sampledLeaves['get view'] milliseconds / sum renderer-main RunTask milliseconds
attribution.sampledGetter: Sampled leaf estimate; overlaps snapshot work and must not be added to snapshot share
attribution.cpuScope: Renderer process includes all renderer threads; GPU process CPU is CPU consumption, not GPU hardware execution time

baseline: Only src/core/memory.ts is temporarily replaced with the pinned tooling-base version during the baseline build, then restored before treatment build
excludedEvidence: All partial artifacts generated before merging the corrected #242 tooling
